digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Today is Wednesday, August 12, with a 12-entry meeting calendar, four collision points, three urgent items, and five carry-overs. The day turns on the 9:00 AM Amazon Connect needs review, the 10:00 AM Salesforce-versus-Legal choice, and the 11:30 AM UAT root-cause discussion. Lock the Amazon Connect plan and ownership trail, enter the RCA with the facts and agreements in hand, and assign coverage before the afternoon meeting stack. The clearest positive change since yesterday is that UAT and production quotas advanced and the program moved from “blood red” to “soft yellow,” but schedule governance and readiness still need executive discipline.

items.label: Check in with the Colombia team
items.detail: Confirm the team is safe and supported after the earthquake, and escalate any immediate needs that remain unresolved.

items.label: Close the Latent Variables reply
items.detail: The external cohort spot has been held while Jean, Danny, and Sara review the recommendation. Decide the path and send the response before the opportunity ages further.

items.label: Terminar Hoja de Jorge
items.detail: Finish the sheet in the first available focus window so it is usable for today's UAT RCA and the next portfolio discussion.

items.label: Submit the Spencer Huffman interview feedback
items.detail: Send the Project Manager III assessment today so the hiring process is no longer waiting on the interview feedback.

items.label: Decide the Incidents Template access requests
items.detail: Andrew Hoke's request remains open and Amy Loesch requested the same document yesterday. Confirm who needs access for current incident-response work and approve or decline both requests consistently.

items.label: 9:00-10:00 AM - Amazon Connect needs and Sara 1:1
items.detail: Use the back-to-back meetings to align the current Amazon Connect status, the leadership narrative, and the decisions that must be carried into the rest of the day.

items.label: 10:00-11:00 AM - Salesforce and Legal collision, then Thiago
items.detail: The Salesforce timeline walkthrough and Legal Change Management sync overlap completely. Choose the live priority, assign coverage for the other, and use Thiago's 10:30 AM 1:1 to close the Amazon Connect owner and schedule questions.

items.label: 11:30 AM-noon - UAT root-cause analysis
items.detail: Bring the recent UAT failure timeline, downstream impact, communications, agreements, and explicit corrective owners so the meeting produces a prevention plan rather than another status recap.

items.label: Noon-1:00 PM - Repository walkthrough versus focus time
items.detail: The Legal Change Management walkthrough consumes most of the protected hour. Decide whether to attend live or preserve coverage, then use the remaining 15 minutes only for a tightly scoped carry-over.

items.label: 2:00-4:00 PM - EPMO, 1:1s, and Operations stack
items.detail: The EPMO team meeting overlaps Astrid at 2:30 PM; the 3:00 PM Operations events overlap Laura at 3:30 PM. Route coverage before lunch and protect the 4:00 PM focus block for decisions created by the stack.

items.label: Lock the Amazon Connect operating plan
items.detail: UAT quotas are approved, 250 UAT numbers are loaded, production exists, and 300 production concurrent calls are approved. Use the 9:00 AM review and Thiago's 1:1 to confirm the source-of-truth plan, remaining production quotas, training dependencies, owners, and the next leadership-ready readiness date.

items.label: Turn the UAT RCA into a corrective plan
items.detail: Before 11:30 AM, assemble the failure sequence, communications, agreements, downstream impact, and accountable owners. Leave the meeting with prevention actions and dates, especially for the sandbox and UAT access issues surfaced yesterday.

items.label: Assign coverage for today's meeting collisions
items.detail: Choose between Salesforce and Legal at 10:00 AM, the repository walkthrough and focus time at noon, EPMO and Astrid at 2:30 PM, and Operations and Laura after 3:00 PM. Send delegates and expected outputs before each conflict begins.

items.label: Review the new Supabase security alert
items.detail: An unread alert says security vulnerabilities were detected in Jean's projects. Verify the affected project and severity, then assign remediation without assuming it is the same issue previously closed.

items.label: Jhara is out from 2:00-4:00 PM
items.detail: Her OOO block overlaps the EPMO meeting and the Operations window. Close Legal Change Management questions before 2:00 PM or identify alternate coverage.

items.label: 10:00-11:30 AM - Amazon Connect training and Armando
items.detail: The morning opens with an Amazon Connect training touchpoint followed by Armando's 1:1. Carry forward any training or ownership gaps identified today.

items.label: Noon-2:45 PM - Three-way noon collision, then BCP and SMS
items.detail: The Legal Guidance rollout, Amazon Connect weekly sync, and protected focus hour all start at noon. Resolve attendance today; BCP/Incident Response follows at 1:30 PM and SMS status at 2:00 PM.
